title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Claim for Payment of Waterway Maintenance Fees May Be Listed as a Maritime Lien

articles.content_en:
December 8, 2003
Supreme People's Court
Reply on Whether the Claim for Payment of Waterway Maintenance Fees May Be Included in Maritime Liens
Fa Shi [2003] No. 18
Higher People's Court of Guangdong Province:
Your request (Yue Gao Fa Jing Er Qing Zi No. 2 [2002]) on whether the claim for payment of waterway maintenance fees may be included in maritime liens has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Regulations on the Administration of Navigable Channels of the People's Republic of China and the Regulations on the Administration of Waterway Transportation of the People's Republic of China, vessels and rafts navigating within China's coastal waters, rivers, lakes and other navigable waters shall pay waterway maintenance fees in accordance with state regulations. Waterway transportation enterprises and other units and individuals engaged in commercial transportation and non-commercial transportation must pay waterway maintenance fees and other fees in accordance with state regulations. Therefore, the claim for payment of waterway maintenance fees may be subject to the provisions of Article 22, paragraph 1, item (3) of the Maritime Law of the People's Republic of China and shall have a maritime lien.
This reply is hereby given.
